South Side Training Ride

St. Louis, MO · Road

South Side Training Ride is a road group ride in St. Louis, MO. It rolls every Saturday at 8:00 am from South Side Cyclery. Pace: a: 32+ mi at 20+ mph. B: 28+ mi at 16-18 mph. C: 24+ mi at 13-15 mph.

For visitors

Free, but a waiver is required (link on the page). A and B riders can drop back a group if needed; there is no designated sweep, so bring the route from the club's Strava page and be ready to navigate.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 16-18 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @southsidecyclery the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the South Side Training Ride group ride

A coached training ride out of the shop. Riders get in-ride coaching on holding momentum over rolling hills, riding a paceline, cornering and timing an attack. Training efforts happen at River City Casino and Jefferson Barracks Park, then a steady tempo ride back to the shop.
